convention: spelling-based Latin transcription; preserve CF hyphenation; not pronunciation-oriented RR
algorithm: Authored sentence readings would take precedence at the existing full-result metadata cache; candidate is currently QA-only with no app membership.
Protect code, URLs, email, Latin names, identifiers and numbers byte-exactly; never normalize the source.
Partition original scalars into protected, modern precomposed Hangul, unresolved non-Latin letters, and literal pieces with exact contiguous UTF16 source ranges.
Apply CF tokenizer LatinTranscription with locale ko to each Hangul-only run. Preserve raw token readings; accept ASCII Latin words and native hyphens only.
Retain every token gap; unresolved Hangul, Han, jamo or other unprotected script produces nil whole reading and explicit diagnostic pieces.
Insert a display space at adjacent alphanumeric converted/literal boundaries; preserve explicit punctuation, whitespace and every opaque literal internally.
Require at least one converted Hangul token; Latin-only input has no redundant transliteration action.
No generic toLatin, phonological rewrites, phrase overrides, audio alteration or model requests.

bound.protection_mask: bounded UTF16 occupancy; no pairwise range scans

integration_if_qualified: FullSentenceReadings authored-first producer, ko-only immutable policy key; once per full translated result outside SwiftUI. No production activation in this proposal.
future_capture: first/warm equality, exact UTF16 piece partition and protected literal reconstruction
raw CF readings and unresolved ranges, input/probe hashes, actual OS and lexical-scheme availability
per-case wall time and process peak RSS; max mixed and max Hangul controls
capacity admission distinct from full app qualification; no model/package downloads
